selector.rationale: The presence of a dark brown, variegated plaque with pagetoid cells and positive staining for CK7 and EMA, along with numerous reactive dendritic HMB-45–positive melanocytes, supports the diagnosis of Pigmented extramammary Paget disease.

rejected.label: Extramammary Paget's Disease
rejected.why: While the clinical presentation and histopathology are consistent with Extramammary Paget's Disease, the presence of pigmentation and HMB-45-positive melanocytes specifically supports the more specific diagnosis of Pigmented extramammary Paget disease.
